#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Load the page in Chromium, collect console errors, screenshot at given sim times."""
import sys, json, time, os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

url = sys.argv[1]
outdir = sys.argv[2]
times = [float(x) for x in sys.argv[3].split(",")] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else [0, 20, 50, 90]
w = int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 1920
h = int(sys.argv[5]) if len(sys.argv) > 5 else 1080
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)

with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=["--use-angle=metal", "--enable-gpu", "--ignore-gpu-blocklist", "--autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required"])
    pg = b.new_page(viewport={"width": w, "height": h})
    logs = []
    pg.on("console", lambda m: logs.append(m.type + ": " + m.text))
    pg.on("pageerror", lambda e: logs.append("PAGEERROR: " + str(e)))
    reqs = []
    pg.on("request", lambda r: reqs.append(r.url))
    t0 = time.time()
    pg.goto(url)
    pg.wait_for_function("window.BENCH_REPORT !== undefined", timeout=60000)
    print("load+replay seconds: %.2f" % (time.time() - t0))
    rep = pg.evaluate("JSON.stringify(window.BENCH_REPORT)")
    print("BENCH_REPORT:", rep)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(500)
    print("countdown:", pg.evaluate("[getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('countdown')).display, document.getElementById('countdown').textContent]"))
    for t in times:
        pg.evaluate("""(t) => { const s = document.getElementById('scrubber'); s.value = String(t); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); }""", t)
        pg.wait_for_timeout(250)
        pg.screenshot(path=os.path.join(outdir, "shot_%05.1f.png" % t))
    # fps measurement: play at 1x from t=60 for 3 s
    fps = pg.evaluate("""() => new Promise(res => {
        const s = document.getElementById('scrubber'); s.value = '60'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true}));
        document.getElementById('btn-toggle').click();
        let n = 0, t0 = performance.now();
        function f() { n++; if (performance.now() - t0 < 3000) requestAnimationFrame(f); else res(n / ((performance.now() - t0) / 1000)); }
        requestAnimationFrame(f);
    })""")
    print("fps (headless, approx): %.1f" % fps)
    print("state after play: scrubber", pg.evaluate("document.getElementById('scrubber').value"), "aria", pg.evaluate("document.getElementById('btn-toggle').getAttribute('aria-label')"))
    print("requests:", [r for r in reqs if not r.startswith("file:")])
    print("console:")
    for l in logs[:40]:
        print("  ", l)
    b.close()

  const o1 = AC.prototype.createOscillator, o2 = AC.prototype.createBufferSource;
  AC.prototype.createOscillator = function () { window.__aud.osc++; return o1.call(this); };
  AC.prototype.createBufferSource = function () { window.__aud.buf++; return o2.call(this); };
  const origCtor = AC;
  window.__ctxs = [];
  window.AudioContext = function () { const c = new origCtor(); window.__ctxs.push(c); return c; };
  window.AudioContext.prototype = origCtor.prototype;
})();
"""
JS_SCRUB = "(t) => { const s = document.getElementById('scrubber'); s.value = String(t); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); }"
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=["--use-angle=metal", "--autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required"])
    pg = b.new_page(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 650})
    errs = []
    pg.on("pageerror", lambda e: errs.append(str(e)))
